name: spotlight-card1

frames.best_why: Frame 1 shows the whole bento grid with all three tiles visible and no cursor over it.

tagline: Photo tiles in a bento grid lit by a faint pointer glow.
summary: A rounded black panel of photo tiles arranged in a bento grid, one large and two small. A faint light tracks the cursor, and one card can carry a heading and paragraph.
appearance: A dark bento grid of image tiles: a square photo of a brick hall sign, a wide sunlit field under a blue gradient sky, and a large pale tile with blue jellyfish-like forms and wisps scattered across it.
behaviour: A faint radial highlight follows the pointer over the tiles and a soft gradient tracks it inside each card. The pictures themselves never move or animate.
demo_content: A brick hall sign, a sunlit field and blue jellyfish images
search_phrases: feature grid with different tile sizes
stat tiles mixed with a big image
bento box layout for a landing page
use_when: A landing section needs varied tile sizes to show several features at once.
avoid_when: Tiles load local webp files from /public, so the grid breaks without those assets.
customise: The five tiles' image paths, titles and spans are a hardcoded array; swapping the webp files and editing that array is the way in.
weight_why: Five static image tiles plus a pointer-tracked gradient.

a11y.note: All images share the alt text "grid", so the tiles are not described.

issues: The heading and paragraph meant for the large card are not visible in any frame.
Every image repeats the same alt text, "grid".
polish_why: Balanced bento proportions and vivid photos, but the promised text block never appears.
